feature: Laporan Change Processing Stage (generate Excel, list laporan per tanggal, download)
story: Tidak ada di OCMS15.6-15.10 (mungkin OCMS15.11 atau story Report; tidak dicek di luar chunk)
note: processBatch membuat laporan setelah simpan (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:142-160); ada endpoint POST /change-processing-stage/reports (maks 90 hari) dan /report/{reportId}. Tiket OCMS-DF-2026-095 menyentuh isi laporan CPS (Closed).
note_en: processBatch generates a report after saving (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:142-160); POST /change-processing-stage/reports (max 90 days) and /report/{reportId} exist. Ticket OCMS-DF-2026-095 touches the CPS report content (Closed).

feature: Email notifikasi error ke ops bila ada notice gagal/warning saat Change Processing Stage
note: sendErrorNotificationAsync dipanggil dari processBatch bila failed/warning > 0 (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:163-185). Apakah email benar terkirim bergantung properti SMTP per environment: cannot verify from repo.
note_en: sendErrorNotificationAsync is called from processBatch when failed/warning > 0 (ChangeOfProcessingService.java:163-185). Whether the email is really sent depends on per-environment SMTP properties: cannot verify from repo.

feature: Pilihan Letter Address (mha_reg, lta_reg, lta_mail, furnished_mail) di form CPS dan update letter_address di ONOD Addr
note: Kolom Letter Address di form CPS dan updateOnodLetterAddress mengganti flag letter_address pada alamat offender saat simpan; story chunk ini tidak menyebut alamat surat.
note_en: The Letter Address column in the CPS form and updateOnodLetterAddress switch the letter_address flag on the offender address when saving; the stories in this chunk do not mention the letter address.

feature: Sinkron langsung field hasil CPS ke eVON (Internet DB) setelah simpan
note: syncCpsFieldsToInternetDb menyalin amount_payable, payment_acceptance_allowed, last/next stage ke eVON; gagal sinkron hanya di-log (soft failure) dan diserahkan ke cron batch-sync.
note_en: syncCpsFieldsToInternetDb copies amount_payable, payment_acceptance_allowed and last/next stage to eVON; a sync failure is only logged (soft failure) and left to the batch-sync cron.
